name: Button
looksLike: filled rectangle you press to do something
clickable box labeled save or submit
rounded control that starts an action
definition: An interactive control that performs an action, such as submitting a form or opening a panel.

notConfusedWith.difference: Represents an on/off setting rather than a one-time action.

prompts.short: Add a button with a clear action label and visible keyboard focus.
prompts.detailed: Add a native button with an explicit type, a descriptive action label, a visible focus ring, and a target at least 44px square. Use a link instead when navigating to another page.

html: <input id="search-query" name="q" type="search" style="min-height:44px; max-width:100%; box-sizing:border-box">
vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Use a native button with an explicit type
Provide an accessible name and visible focus
Support Enter and Space with a 44px target
